summary: Atlas Lithium Corp filed an 8-K reporting that the permitting commission of Minas Gerais, Brazil granted an expansion permit on June 26, 2026, published on June 27, 2026. The permit covers additional mining areas beyond a prior operational permit, authorizing assembly and operation of a lithium processing plant, processing of mined ore, and sale of lithium concentrate. The filing is a routine operational update on regulatory progress, not a special situation transaction. No financial terms, advisor, or deal mechanics are involved. The company continues advancing its Neves Project per its Definitive Feasibility Study. Watch for future production milestones.
